parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%e %b') AS day, (t.start_date <= CURDATE()) AS started, tm.id AS team_id, tm.name AS team_name, e.id AS eid, e.status AS estatus, d.name AS dname, d.min_age, d.max_age, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, $4, t.start_date) AS age_on_day, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING') AND LOWER(x.guest_name) = LOWER($3) AND x.guest_birthdate = $4) AS dup, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status = 'PENDING') AS pending FROM tournament_web_links l JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = l.tournament_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.code = $2 JOIN tournament_entries e ON e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.team_id = tm.id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id WHERE l.slug = $1
